key_quote: the absence of sufficient conditions guaranteeing low TT rank... the tool provides formal verification conditional on an unverified assumption
rationale: All reviewers find the Metzler semigroup error contraction, three-valued semantics, and O(N) complexity separation genuinely novel. The critiques focus on execution depth: missing compressibility theorem, unanalyzed TDVP convergence for non-Hermitian operators, no PRISM/Storm verdict comparison, and inadequate clamping bias analysis — all depth/rigor issues.
